scientific_limitations: Fixed standard Brownian diffusion normalization and exactly anti-periodic endpoint tie; no independent constant Gaussian offset.
The law of a broader Slepian-type family and discrete-approximation error bounds are not addressed.
Historical equivalence to an older, unindexed exact anti-periodic extreme-value result has not been definitively excluded.
title: Exact absolute-excursion law and uniform peak location for anti-periodic Brownian motion
